exceptions.rationale: The affected esbuild development server is present only through drizzle-kit tooling. Generated commands use drizzle-kit generate and migrate and never invoke esbuild serve.
exceptions.mitigation: Keep the development server API unexposed and re-evaluate the chain whenever drizzle-kit or its loader dependencies change.

exceptions.rationale: The affected uuid APIs are buffered v3, v5, and v6 calls. The pinned MSAL implementation imports uuid v4 only, and SDK 1.2.7 is the newest release that retains Liftoff's project-local power-apps CLI contract.
exceptions.mitigation: Do not introduce buffered uuid calls. Re-evaluate when Liftoff adopts Microsoft's global pa CLI architecture or a compatible project-local CLI removes the affected uuid dependency.
